svg.title: NeoDSE API routes and request flow
svg.desc: All control API methods grouped by capability, including screen borders, serial peripherals and supported broadcasts. The request flow shows bearer authentication, role and agent scope checks and asynchronous results. Public process liveness is separate from authenticated readiness.
svg.text: NeoDSE API routes and request flow
Methods and role capabilities from internal/server/routes.go · Endpoint contracts: internal/swagger/openapi.yaml
Read access: any authenticated role; agent and event scope still apply

svg.text: All listed control routes use this prefix.
Save desired content or queue actions.
Saved content can wait for reconnect.
Check delivery state and agent receipts.
No bearer token; separate from readiness.
Method colors identify the required capability.
Administrator grants every capability and scope.
Events require access to all their target agents.
Playlist updates persist while agents are offline; only the latest content is applied.
Banners, borders, audio, hardware and host actions require an online agent.
Broadcasts report results per target; failures can differ between displays.
A 202 response accepts work. Poll the event to inspect delivery and execution.
Uncertain delivery may have executed; it is never automatically retried.
